original_preserved: The first original_pages PDF pages are copied intact, not redrawn. The original paper text is not rewritten. The extension follows the original paper and appendices.

figures.bandit_explanations: Entry-policy explanations. Put bars measure actual tree-path usage; straddle bars measure how often centering an input changes proposed size. The measures have different definitions and are not causal effects.
figures.learning_layers: The extension adds a second signal and an outer allocation decision. The original put-pair framework remains the first strategy; its retained entry policy is frozen.
figures.q_evaluation: Four risk preferences with the original nine-input Q state versus seven fixed capital splits, 2022–August 2025. Gray labels give put/straddle weights. Lines connect discrete results rather than a fitted frontier; the table also reports validation performance.
figures.q_context: Penalty-0.20 Q: fraction of later decisions changed when one input is set to its monthly training center, holding the other actual state values fixed.
figures.q_schedule: The saved Q policy mostly switches between the two strategy indices. These are capital weights, rather than the fraction of cash spent on options. Only fitted decisions are shown.
figures.q_timing: Matched controls at penalty 0.20. The average-weight control uses the realized mean target retrospectively; the discount-zero learner uses the same reward, features, data and regularization as Q.
